title: 19-BCV-023 - Insulation values for flat or cathedral roofs serving residential garages

facts.text: The variance addresses insulation values for flat or cathedral roofs above attached garages and heated detached garages serving residential occupancies.
For this scope, it allows the Section 9.36 tables’ thermal-resistance values to be used instead of the 9.25.2.1 roof-ceiling value.
The cited 9.36 tables distinguish values by climate zone and whether a heat-recovery ventilator is present.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
